name: Banisteriopsis caapi
summary: Banisteriopsis caapi is a documented other compound on PsychonautWiki.

uses.text: It is used to prepare ayahuasca, a decoction with a long history of its entheogenic use and its status as a "plant teacher" among the indigenous peoples of the Amazon rainforest.

pharmacology.en: Its main alkaloids are harmine, harmaline and tetrahydroharmine. The first two reversibly block monoamine oxidase A, the enzyme that breaks down DMT in the gut, which is what makes DMT work when drunk.
pharmacology.zh: 它的主要生物鹼是駱駝蓬鹼、駱駝蓬靈與四氫駱駝蓬鹼。前兩者可逆地阻斷單胺氧化酶 A，也就是在腸道分解 DMT 的酵素，這使 DMT 在飲用時仍能發揮作用。
pharmacology.zhHans: 它的主要生物碱是骆驼蓬碱、骆驼蓬灵与四氢骆驼蓬碱。前两者可逆地阻断单胺氧化酶 A，也就是在肠道分解 DMT 的酵素，这使 DMT 在饮用时仍能发挥作用。

sideEffects.en: The vine itself commonly causes nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, sweating and tremor. Because it blocks monoamine oxidase, it can cause a dangerous rise in blood pressure with tyramine-rich foods such as aged cheese, and raises the risk of serotonin syndrome.
sideEffects.zh: 卡披木本身常造成噁心、嘔吐、腹瀉、出汗與顫抖。由於它阻斷單胺氧化酶，與陳年乳酪等富含酪胺的食物並用可能造成血壓危險升高，並提高血清素症候群的風險。
sideEffects.zhHans: 卡披木本身常造成恶心、呕吐、腹泻、出汗与颤抖。由于它阻断单胺氧化酶，与陈年奶酪等富含酪胺的食物并用可能造成血压危险升高，并提高血清素症候群的风险。

fact.en: The vine is the backbone of ayahuasca, and Amazonian peoples call it the plant teacher. Its beta-carboline alkaloids were once given the name telepathine, before chemists realised they were the already known harmine and harmaline.
fact.zh: 卡披木是死藤水的主幹，亞馬遜民族稱它為「植物老師」。它的 β 咔啉生物鹼曾被命名為 telepathine，後來化學家才發現它們其實是早已知曉的駱駝蓬鹼與駱駝蓬靈。
fact.zhHans: 卡披木是死藤水的主干，亚马逊民族称它为「植物老师」。它的 β 咔啉生物碱曾被命名为 telepathine，后来化学家才发现它们其实是早已知晓的骆驼蓬碱与骆驼蓬灵。
